
Mixed mating outcrossing rate database.xls   Column variables
Column A:	Reference
Column B:	Publication year
Column C:	Family
Column D:	Genus
Column E:	Species
Column F:	genus species
Column G:	Monocot/Dicot/Gymnosperm  coded as M/D/G
Column H:	Life form (0=annual, 1=herbaceous perennial, 2=woody perennial)
Column I:	Pollination mode (0=animal, 1=wind, 2=water)
Column J:	Marker type  (I=isozyme, F=floral polymorphism, M=morphological polymoRphism, U=microsatellite marker, R= RAPD
Column K:	Number of markers
Column L:	Population type used in the study (0=natural, 1= experimental, 2=seed orchard, 3=agricultural)
Column M:	nPops(t)  Number of populations in this study; comment contains the number of years
Column N:	Mean tm  Mean multi-locus estimate of outcrossing rate, t
Column O:	Mean ts  Mean single-locus estimate of outcrossing rate, t
Column P:	Upper tm  Highest value of multi-locus estimate of outcrossing rate, t
Column Q:	Where t is found in the reference
Column R:	NPops(F)  Number of populations for which F values (inbreeding coefficients) are present
Column S:	Mode of selfing= auton=autonomous, geit=geitonogamous, none=no selfing, biparental, 0=none, cleis=cleistogamous
Column T:	Used for t and F  (0=no, 1=yes)
Column U:	Mean-F= mean value of F (inbreeding coefficients) across populations or year
Column V:	Lower F = lowest value of F (inbreeding coefficient) across populations or year
Column W:	Upper F = highest value of F (inbreeding coefficient) across populations or year
Column X:	Where F is found in the reference
Column Y:	Full citation for reference
